Complete maintenance tools set,

Cleaning fluid,

Uncouple the hydraulic coupling from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment between the pump and hydraulic coupling.
Clean the coupling and fill it with a new grease.
Inspect the front and rear journal bearing.
Inspect and repack the front and rear glands with new packing if required
Inspect and clean the cooling water and oil tubes
Inspect and clean the oil filter
Realign the hydraulic coupling to the pump
Reconnect the coupling bolts

Inspect and repack the glands if required for this valves:
 * Main delivery 
 * Injection * 
 Heating 
 * Min. flow * Main cooling 
 * Suction 
 * Drain
Uncouple the motor from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment.
Inspect the front and rear bearing.
Inspect and repack the gland with new packing if required.
Inspect and clean the cooling water tubes.
Realign the motor to the pump.
Reconnect the coupling bolts.
Uncouple the motor from the hydraulic coupling by removing the coupling bolts.

Clean the coupling and fill it with new grease between the hydraulic 
 coupling and motor
Inspect and clean the cooling water and oil tubes
Inspect and clean the oil cooler if required
Inspect and adjust the scoop tube
Realign the motor to the hydraulic coupling
Reconnect the coupling bolts

Introduction
This 
 document outlines the high pressure feed water pump inspection, which must be performed 
 every 1500 hours of operation
The pump technical data:
Type : 
 centrifugal pump multistage Speed: 
 2880 RPM
No of 
 stages (1-14) 
 Power 2000 KW 
 Head: 1990 m
Suction 
 press. 9 bar 
 Max. flow rate: 200 m3/h
The first draft initiated by eng.Ahmed Fakhr El-Din Abd El-Gelil, reviewed & 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah Mohamed Shehata, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr Eldawar Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes ... etc.

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set,
 Grease gun
Cleaning fluid,
 Turbo oil 32
Alignment device
Work to be Carried Out
Feed Pump
Uncouple the hydraulic coupling from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment between the pump and hydraulic coupling.
Clean the coupling and fill it with a new grease.
Inspect the front and rear journal bearing.
Inspect and repack the front and rear glands with new packing if required
Inspect and clean the cooling water and oil tubes
Inspect and clean the oil filter
Realign the hydraulic coupling to the pump
Reconnect the coupling bolts
Inspect and repack the glands if required for this valves:
 * Main delivery 
 * Injection * 
 Heating 
 * Min. flow * Main cooling 
 * Suction 
 * Drain
Booster Feed Pump
Uncouple the motor from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment.
Inspect the front and rear bearing.
Inspect and repack the gland with new packing if required.
Inspect and clean the cooling water tubes.
Realign the motor to the pump.
Reconnect the coupling bolts.
Hydraulic Coupling
Uncouple the motor from the hydraulic coupling by removing the coupling bolts.
Clean the coupling and fill it with new grease between the hydraulic 
 coupling and motor
Inspect and clean the cooling water and oil tubes
Inspect and clean the oil cooler if required
Inspect and adjust the scoop tube
Realign the motor to the hydraulic coupling
Reconnect the coupling bolts
